details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which sends an HTTP POST of a JSON body containing the package name, hostname, install path, working directory, npm user-agent and protocol to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with an x-beacon-package header. index.js fires the same beacon when the module is required and exports a Proxy whose properties are no-op functions, so a build that imports the real package name completes instead of crashing. The beacon collects only host and install metadata; no credentials, tokens, environment values or file contents are read or transmitted.
